name: Belize Kids Website
install: export NVM_DIR="$HOME/.nvm"; . "$NVM_DIR/nvm.sh"; nvm install 24 >/dev/null; export PATH="$NVM_DIR/versions/node/$(nvm version 24)/bin:$PATH"; npm ci

terminals.name: dev
terminals.command: export NVM_DIR="$HOME/.nvm"; . "$NVM_DIR/nvm.sh"; export PATH="$NVM_DIR/versions/node/$(nvm version 24)/bin:$PATH"; npm run dev
